acceptanceCriteria: A committed harness reproduces heartbeat/renew p50/p99 at 40k receipts with 15 writers and records host load.
body: PR #1415 (JSG lane, seal 2bd689f67) delivered V1-0887/V1-1512 partially; measured only under host load 20-35 (12 cores), so shape only. V1-1512 p99 at 40k receipts/15 writers went 1138/1131 ms -> 304/406 ms (target 250 ms) measured ad hoc; the B3 harness/S7 stage is not built.
title: Tasks perf: build the B3 benchmark harness (S7) for repeatable heartbeat/renew p99 measurement
